blocks.text: Yasmien Kurdi recounted the traumatic experience and the medical ordeal she went through following the alleged bullying of her daughter Ayesha, saying her journey through law school was one of the outlets that helped her heal. The celebrity mom recalled how she was initially unsure about entering law school, admitting she was surprised after she passed the entrance examination. “Noong una, hindi ko talaga alam kung tama ba na nag-law school ako. Pero ngayon, unti-unti kong nakikita na calling pala talaga siya. Somehow, it brought me here, and maybe, exactly where I needed to be,” she said on her Instagram page […]...
